skills.name: yeknal-application-security

skills.name: yeknal-brandkit

skills.name: yeknal-break-ui

skills.name: yeknal-code-graph

Builds a zero-dependency local index of content terms plus imports, routes and tests, then answers with a small ranked slice inside a token budget. skills.name: yeknal-content-seo

skills.name: yeknal-deploy

skills.name: yeknal-design-reference-research

skills.name: yeknal-design-system

skills.name: yeknal-design-taste-frontend
skills.description: Design and build expressive landing pages, portfolios, and marketing interfaces from product evidence instead of reusable AI recipes, including showcase-level art direction. For an existing product use `yeknal-redesign-existing-projects`.

skills.name: yeknal-domain-modeling

skills.name: yeknal-frontend-design

skills.name: yeknal-frontend-developer

skills.name: yeknal-high-end-visual-design
skills.description: Create premium, art-directed web interfaces with a product-specific visual thesis, expressive type, deliberate composition, material, imagery, and motion. Use only for showcase-level or agency-style briefs.

skills.name: yeknal-human-ai-interface-design
skills.description: Design AI-mediated interfaces that earn appropriate reliance: capability, provenance, uncertainty, approval, failure, and recovery. Use when an AI feature proposes, generates, retrieves, or acts, and the user must verify, approve, or undo it.

skills.name: yeknal-implement
skills.description: Implement a scoped feature or fix end to end while preserving repository behavior. Use when the user asks to build, change, add, or repair code; not for the closing gates, review, or publication, which is `yeknal-finalize`.

skills.name: yeknal-improve-animations
skills.description: Audit animation and motion code and produce prioritized, self-contained plans for another agent to execute; never edits source. Use when asked to improve or audit the motion, not to review one diff (`yeknal-review-animations`).

skills.name: yeknal-industrial-brutalist-ui
skills.description: Design data-heavy interfaces in industrial brutalism style, fusing Swiss print typography with military terminal aesthetics. Use when the brief asks for rigid grids, extreme type-scale contrast, utilitarian color, or halftones and scanlines.

skills.name: yeknal-launch-readiness
skills.description: Audit a product for launch readiness before it becomes publicly reachable: legal obligations plus the engineering gates no other workflow owns, then one register and a go or no-go. Use when asked whether an app can ship.

skills.name: yeknal-legacy-sweep
skills.description: Prove legacy code and tests are obsolete before deleting them, repair real defects instead of removing the test that caught them, and keep the coverage that protects behaviour. Use for a dead-code sweep, "remove unused imports", or a test-suite prune.

skills.name: yeknal-markdown-management
skills.description: Create, merge, update, or audit Markdown without losing meaning, links, authority, or repository conventions. Use for README, docs, and Agent Skill maintenance.

skills.name: yeknal-minimalist-ui

skills.name: yeknal-mobile-app-design

skills.name: yeknal-oil-motion

skills.name: yeknal-orchestration-specialists

skills.name: yeknal-performance

skills.name: yeknal-pick-ui-library

skills.name: yeknal-redesign-existing-projects

skills.name: yeknal-research-analysis

skills.name: yeknal-security-audit
